title: The prescribed coherent pullback stage morphism
statement: Given the coherence law for the rational derived pullbacks and their prescribed normalized transition comparisons, assemble these data into the literal morphism of coefficient stage systems. Its components and comparisons are exactly the prescribed functors and isomorphisms; only its proof field is supplied by the coherence hypothesis.

source.place: Compatibility; finite-stage representative and supplied-operation normalization.

lean.statement:
def commonProjectionPullbackStages
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (hc : StageSystem.pairFunctorCoherent (stageSystem l Ω Y) (stageSystem l Ω X)
      (fun L ↦ rationalDerivedPullback l
        (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient l Ω L) f)
      (commonStagePullbackTransition l Ω f)) :
    (stageSystem l Ω Y).Morphism (stageSystem l Ω X)
